SELECT to_char(applied_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS recorded_at,
                 cr_id AS resource_id
             FROM change_requests WHERE project_id=$1::uuid AND pipeline_session_id=$2::uuid AND applied_at IS NOT NULL
              ORDER BY applied_at DESC, cr_id DESC LIMIT $3::int;

SELECT to_char(applied_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS recorded_at,
                 cr_id AS resource_id
             FROM change_requests WHERE project_id=$1::uuid AND pipeline_session_id=$2::uuid AND applied_at IS NOT NULL
             AND applied_at=$4::timestamptz AND cr_id<$5::uuid ORDER BY applied_at DESC, cr_id DESC LIMIT $3::int;
